judge.voice: Look, the supplier scene was right on target: certificates, truck times, my real Monday. Ravi spoke at a sensible pace and I never felt slowed down. The reasons were short and I could not argue with "by means no later than that day". Recap with saved fixes (more better, he don't) was useful. But the worst one, "we was", I said twice and nobody touched it, and it even marked my retry "fixed" with it still there. I'd say that is my main problem. Also B1 appears with just "self-chosen" and no reason, so why should I believe it? Three stops in seven turns plus retries felt a bit schoolish. I'd use it again for meeting practice, but I need evidence about my level before I tell the director's team.
